title: Pretty towels, Not very thick and fluffy
text:
Pretty towels, Not very thick and fluffy. . These towels are pretty but not quite thick or fluffy enough for my taste; I haven't washed them yet. I hope they hold their color.
I didn't wash these before using (just no time), and they didn't leave lint or fuzz on me.
)
